title: Straw Men #3 All-American Comics 1989 Mutant Baby Cover Horror Comic
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Straw Men #3 (1989), All-American Comics. Cover shows a man in a purple robe holding a grinning mutant baby. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.65 in Canada).

Back cover: full-color art of a man in a blue suit and a giant face.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
